svg.title: Security architecture for the DLI course Securing Agents with OpenShell and NemoClaw
svg.desc: The Target of Evaluation is course source and CI definitions, the static artifact, and course client code. Hosting, CI execution, the browser environment, model services, runtime services, and relays are external dependencies whose live controls are not attested here. Threat enumeration is limited to the numbered flows and their listed security objectives. External operator internals are excluded.
svg.text: Security architecture for the DLI course Securing Agents with OpenShell and NemoClaw
Course-owned nodes are solid green. External dependencies are dashed gray; their live controls are not attested here.
EXTERNAL HOSTING — LIVE CONTROLS NOT ATTESTED
EXTERNAL SERVICES — LIVE CONTROLS NOT ATTESTED

polyline.title: source_to_ci: Git transport; live host configuration unverified; proposed public source and commit metadata; auth: developer identity and review policy; operator evidence required; boundary: TOE source to external source host and CI execution
ci_to_artifact: external CI execution of course workflow; public static course bundle; auth: CI job identity; live runner controls unverified; boundary: external build execution to TOE artifact

artifact_to_pages: manifest-bound repository workflow artifact handoff; selected public course files and complete SHA-256 inventory; auth: protected deployment identity requested by workflow; live host and runner rules unverified; boundary: TOE artifact to external static host

artifact_to_launchable: external vendoring integration; public static course tree and integration metadata; auth: external release identities; no live evidence; boundary: TOE artifact to external launchable

pages_to_browser: declared HTTPS route; live host configuration unverified; public course pages and assets; auth: public or host-controlled access; live policy unverified; boundary: external static host to TOE client code in learner device

launchable_to_browser: declared same-origin HTTPS bootstrap; live configuration unverified; course pages, assets, and browser-readable startup credential; auth: external launchable session; no live evidence; boundary: external launchable to TOE client code in learner device

browser_to_models: browser HTTPS request; optional external iframe relay; learner API credential, prompts, and responses; auth: browser-readable bearer credential; external service validation unverified; boundary: TOE client code to external model service

browser_to_nemoclaw: browser HTTPS/WebSocket; reviewed relay or direct browser-session route; gateway credential, agent requests and events; relay session on relay route only; auth: tab-scoped course credentials; HttpOnly launchable session remains browser-bound; external runtime validation unverified; boundary: TOE client code to external NemoClaw integration endpoint

svg.text: THREAT ENUMERATION BOUNDARY · DECLARED FLOWS ONLY

text.tspan: Enumerate threats only for the declared edges and only for each edge's listed security objectives. Do not infer additional flows from external context.
Direct and operator-relayed variants from course client code to the same external service remain one Target of Evaluation boundary flow.
Course source & CI definitions → External CI execution & review
objectives: Integrity · Availability · via Git transport; live host configuration unverified ·
data: proposed public source and commit metadata
auth: developer identity and review policy; operator evidence required · boundary: TOE source
to external source host and CI execution
External CI execution & review → Static course artifact
objectives: Integrity · Availability · via external CI execution of course workflow · data:
public static course bundle
auth: CI job identity; live runner controls unverified · boundary: external build execution to
TOE artifact
Static course artifact → External static host
objectives: Integrity · Availability · via manifest-bound repository workflow artifact handoff
· data: selected public course files and complete SHA-256 inventory
auth: protected deployment identity requested by workflow; live host and runner rules
unverified · boundary: TOE artifact to external static host
Static course artifact → External co-located launchable
objectives: Integrity · Availability · via external vendoring integration · data: public
static course tree and integration metadata
auth: external release identities; no live evidence · boundary: TOE artifact to external
launchable
External static host → Course client code
objectives: Integrity · Availability · via declared HTTPS route; live host configuration
unverified · data: public course pages and assets
auth: public or host-controlled access; live policy unverified · boundary: external static
host to TOE client code in learner device
External co-located launchable → Course client code
objectives: Confidentiality · Integrity · Availability · via declared same-origin HTTPS
bootstrap; live configuration unverified · data: course pages, assets, and browser-readable
auth: external launchable session; no live evidence · boundary: external launchable to TOE
client code in learner device
Course client code → External model service
objectives: Confidentiality · Integrity · Availability · via browser HTTPS request; optional
external iframe relay · data: learner API credential, prompts, and responses
auth: browser-readable bearer credential; external service validation unverified · boundary:
TOE client code to external model service
Course client code → External NemoClaw runtime
objectives: Confidentiality · Integrity · Availability · via browser HTTPS/WebSocket; reviewed
relay or direct browser-session route · data: gateway credential, agent requests and events;
auth: tab-scoped course credentials; HttpOnly launchable session remains browser-bound;
external runtime validation unverified · boundary: TOE client code to external NemoClaw
